Mobile · 2025

NeuraPath

STEM Career Recommender

Role
Product Designer & iOS Builder
Stack
SwiftUI / NLP / ML / Forms / Career Matching
Award
1st place, National Swift Changemakers Hackathon 2025 (Bosch Challenge)

NeuraPath helps students discover STEM career paths through a mobile experience that combines personality signals, learning preferences, and lightweight game interactions. The app was built during the National Swift Changemakers Hackathon 2025 for the Bosch Challenge.

The challenge

The Bosch Challenge at the National Swift Changemakers Hackathon 2025 asked for technology with social impact. We chose vocational guidance: many students choose a career before they know which STEM paths fit them, and we wanted a test that never steers anyone by gender.

A test without bias

The assessment combines 16 personality types and multiple intelligences, written so no question or result is framed by gender. NLP reads open answers to add context to the match.

From result to enrollment

The flow connects the assessment, the career match and university enrollment actions, so a result leads to a next step instead of a dead end.

How I built it

I designed the flows and built the app in SwiftUI, keeping interactions short and game-like so the test feels fast.

Outcome

NeuraPath won 1st place in the Bosch Challenge.
